newsitem.title: USA: Worrying recent trend in US-Japan trade-Barshefsky.
newsitem.headline: Worrying recent trend in US-Japan trade-Barshefsky.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative nominee Charlene Barshefsky said on Wednesday she was worried by recent trends in U.S. trade with Japan, saying it could point to the return of growing U.S. deficits.

"We will be particularly vigilant on Japan questions, especially in light of the fact that we see some disturbing trends in the trade figures in the last two or three months, suggesting perhaps a return to some increase in the trade deficit with Japan," Barshefsky said.
Barshefsky made the remarks as part of her oral statement to members of the Senate Finance Committee who were conducting her confirmation hearing.
